WITH city_counts AS (
    SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendees
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip
    GROUP BY z.city
), city_shares AS (
    SELECT city,
           attendees,
           1.0 * attendees / SUM(attendees) OVER () AS share
    FROM city_counts
), averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(attendees) AS avg_attendees,
           AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM city_shares
)
SELECT AVG(cs.attendees) AS avg_attendees,
       AVG(cs.share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(cs.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_share
FROM city_shares AS cs
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE cs.share > a.avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Counts each attendance record as one attendee and groups records by city name across all events; members whose ZIP has no matching zip_code row are excluded. City share is that city's fraction of all included attendance records, and the averages are unweighted across qualifying cities.
